title: Lantern-Lipped Lollopfish
statement: A plump, periwinkle fish with a dangling glow-lantern that it swings like a tiny lighthouse, lollopping slowly through a tank of dusk-colored water. It is shy about being admired, so it ducks behind a ring of mossy teacups and ferns whenever someone looks too long, then peeks out to blink its lantern as a thank-you.
